location: L23 ceiling void / CHW riser R2 branch above L22 tenant ceiling
description: Chilled-water leak from the AHU-23-01 supply branch above the L22 tenant ceiling. Water tracked to within 1.5 m of distribution board DB-23A; AHU-23-01 switched off and its DB-23A circuit isolated. Branch sub-valve ISV-L23-CHW closed at 08:09 (riser left open). LEW dispatched. Re-energisation blocked pending LEW sign-off, insulation resistance test and area dry.

actions.decision: Isolate at the nearest isolation sub-valve — branch before riser
Send first notice to affected tenants within 30 min
Account-manager phone call to the bank anchor tenant

audit_trail.detail: ISV-L23-CHW branch isolation sub-valve closed; riser left open
Duty LEW Rahul Menon dispatched for DB-23A / AHU-23-01 inspection

location: Data Hall 2, CRAH-DH2-01 condensate drain pan / CHW branch
description: CRAH-DH2-01 condensate drain-pan overflow in Data Hall 2 wetted the unit's fan section; unit switched off and isolated, branch sub-valve ISV-DC-DH2 closed. N+1 maintained (CRAH-DH2-02 carrying load). No IT power-down. Hyperscale client SLA notice owned by the Critical Facilities Manager (15-minute window). Return to service needs LEW sign-off and CFM co-signature.

escalate_to.name: Steven Wong
escalate_to.note: Data-centre override: Critical Facilities Manager co-signs

actions.decision: Isolate at the nearest isolation sub-valve — branch before riser
Contain the data-hall leak and escalate to the Critical Facilities Manager
Client SLA notice via the Critical Facilities Manager within 15 min
actions.note: Data-centre overlay: the tenant first notice (TE-01) does not apply; the client SLA notice replaces it

reuse_demo_note: Same Technical Services pill applied to the colocation DC profile: the tenant first notice (TE-01) disappears, the client SLA notice via the CFM (TE-06) appears, and TS-07 escalates to the Critical Facilities Manager. Model swap (hy4-preview -> deepseek-v4-pro) gives the identical decision because gates are deterministic.

location: L15 ceiling void, AHU-15-02 condensate drain
description: Condensate drain blockage on AHU-15-02 causing minor ceiling staining. Isolated at unit level. No tenant impact. Condensate, not chilled water — riser isolation not required.
outcome: Drain cleared, ceiling tiles replaced. No re-energisation gate triggered — condensate only.

location: B1 mechanical riser, CHW supply pipe joint failure
description: CHW supply pipe joint failure in B1 riser. Water entered switchgear room B1-ER-01 perimeter (within 2 m of SWGR-B1-01). LEW isolated, insulation resistance test passed, area dried before re-energisation.
outcome: LEW sign-off obtained. No equipment damage. 4h switchgear downtime for inspection.

location: L5 roof, above cold storage ceiling
description: Roof membrane failure during extreme precipitation. Water ingress above cold storage. Isolated at zone level. No electrical hazard. Product protected by bunding.
outcome: Roof patched, product safe, no SLA breach.

location: L12 domestic water riser DW-R1, unit 12-05
description: Domestic water leak from riser joint in residential unit. Isolated at floor valve. No electrical hazard. Resident relocated overnight.
outcome: Joint repaired, unit dried within 48h. No mould.

location: Data Hall 3, CRAH-DH3-02 condensate pan overflow
description: CRAH condensate pan overflow in DH-3. Leak detector triggered. CRAH isolated, N+1 redundancy absorbed load. Client notified within SLA. No outage.
outcome: Pan cleared, CRAH returned to service. No SLA credit triggered.

location: L28 AHU-28-01 CHW supply branch, above L27 tenant ceiling
description: CHW supply branch coupling failure on L28 above the L27 bank tenant ceiling. Branch isolated at the sub-valve 12 minutes after the alarm (riser left open). Water reached within 0.8 m of DB-27B; LEW dispatched, insulation resistance test failed initially (moisture in trunking) and passed after 3 h drying.
outcome: Isolated in 12 min — inside v1.2.0's 15-min deadline, outside the Chief Engineer's 10. LEW sign-off after 3 h; no energisation before the test passed.
learning_note: Chief Engineer's outcome review: in a tenant-occupied area isolation must be complete within 10 minutes, not 15 — if sub-valve access cannot be arranged in 10, go to the riser. Drives the TS-02 deadline correction v1.2.0 -> v1.3.0 (eval-2025-09-tenant-area-isolation-deadline).
